notes.title: Under Dead 1.0: The Progression Update!
notes.content:
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Progression System
[*] 2 New Maps
[*] 9 New Items
[*] 9 New Abilities
[*] 9 New Weapons
[*] 5 New Classes
[*] 2 New Enemies
[*] 8 New Achievements
[/list]

[h3]New Progression System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Items are no longer unlocked by achievements
[*] All items, abilities, and weapons are now unlocked by default
[*] Classes, maps, and difficulty modes now require unlocking
[*] Unlock them by simply playing. The more days you survive and zombies you kill, the more progression XP you earn
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[b]User Interface & Visual Feedback[/b]
[list]
[*] Stats on game over screen no longer show +0
[*] Item descriptions now break into multiple lines for readability
[*] Crit damage is no longer shown on the player stats
[*] Shop rerolls are now shown on the player stats
[*] Armor (new stat) is now shown on the player stats
[*] Changed the icon of game options to one more intuitive—the previous one resembled a settings icon, which could be confusing
[*] Added a nice effect when enemies drop items: items now go up and down in a curve to make drops clearer and more satisfying
[*] The help message from survivors now disappears when they start following the player
[*] The help message now also wobbles to draw more attention
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a sound when activating the shop lever
[*] Most sounds now have pitch variation for better feel
[/list]

[b]Unlocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Only one kill is now needed to unlock an enemy’s picture and name in the bestiary (was 5)
[*] Only need to pick up an item once to unlock its name, picture, and description (was 3)
[*] “Lucky” achievement now requires 17 Luck (was 77)
[*] “Miraculous” achievement now requires 77 Luck (was 177)
[/list]

[b]Weapon & Combat Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Dropped weapons now save reload status, bullets, and mag size
[*] Improved dual-wield shooting coordination
[*] Many weapons now have special descriptions (e.g., piercing)
[*] Special bullets now have more synergy with items, abilities, and weapons
[/list]

[b]Menus[/b]
[list]
[*] All menu options like class, difficulty, and map are now remembered when returning to the class menu
[/list]

[b]Explosions[/b]
[list]
[*] Explosions still don’t damage the player as intended, but now push the player based on distance and intensity. Players must be more cautious when detonating large explosions nearby due to the risk of being launched into dangerous positions
[*] Explosions now have a minimum range regardless of damage, ensuring even low-damage explosions affect an area
[*] Slightly increased the size of explosion particles to better match the area they cover
[*] Explosion screen shake now scales with explosion size
[/list]

[b]Bullets[/b]
[list]
[*] Bullets now have some random speed—some weapons have more bullet speed randomness than others (e.g., shotguns)
[*] All bullets can now pierce if they deal 4x the target’s max HP, making high-damage, low-DPS builds more viable
[/list]

[b]Game Balance & Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Day 15 length increased by 20%
[*] Difficulty 1 is now 20% harder
[*] The default difficulty is now Difficulty 1, not 2
[*] Game starts 50% easier, but difficulty scales 15% faster
[*] Survivors will now speed up if too far from the player
[*] Random class no longer starts with fewer items on the highest difficulty
[*] Now, some structures like bear traps have a 50% chance to remain after returning from the shop
[/list]

[b]Armor[/b]
[list]
[*] Armor is a new mechanic that reduces all damage by 1 per armor point (minimum 1 damage received)
[*] Armor also slows the rate of tick damage from effects like fire, toxic spit, or axes
[/list]

[b]Knockback[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved knockback for enemies and the player. Knockback directions are now calculated separately for x and y, resulting in more intuitive behavior. Previously, a small push from a different direction could completely override existing knockback
[/list]

[b]Lighting[/b]
[list]
[*] Toxic puddles now emit green light instead of the default yellowish one
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Changes[/h3]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Now all body parts dropped by enemies (arms, heads, spiders, etc.) will drop on fire if the enemy was burning when killed
[*] Enemies with a lot of HP now drop slightly more coins than before
[*] Zombie hands now crawl on the ground instead of moving at a constant speed
[*] Reduced speed of Fat Zombie by 25%
[*] Zombie Backpack’s backpack color changed from gray to orange, to increase its visibility on the battlefield
[*] Reduced HP of Zombie Skeleton from 200 to 60, but it now has 80% damage reduction—making it a soft counter to high burst, low DPS weapons (the opposite of the Meat Zombie)
[*] Reduced Meat Zombie regeneration by 200%
[/list]

[b]Spider Zombie Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Spider Zombie no longer spawns spider eggs
[*] Now spawns significantly more spiders on death
[*] Spider webs now slow by 35% (was 20%), and the projectile speed has been increased by 15%.
[*] Spider webs now stick to the player, visually indicating the slow effect
[*] If you get close to a Spider Zombie while stuck in a web, it will kill itself to spawn a swarm of baby spiders that instantly charge the player
[*] Spider Zombies now start appearing on Day 4 (was Day 3)
[/list]

[h3]Item changes[/h3]
[list][*] Random Bullets:[list]
[*] Chance per bullet: +1% → +2%[/list][/list][list]
[*] Big Bullets:[list]
[*] Chance: 10% → 5%[/list][/list][list]
[*] Curved Bullets:[list]
[*] Damage: x1.2 → x1.25[/list][/list][list]
[*] Explosive Bullets:[list]
[*] Chance: 10% → 5%
[*] Now explosive bullets only deals explosion damage (no impact damage)[/list][/list][list]
[*] Lucky Bullet:[list]
[*] Effect removed → +20 Luck and -25% Reload 
[*] New effect → 15% chance to shoot again per shot[/list][/list][list]
[*] Gold Bullets:[list]
[*] Effect removed → -1 coin per shot, but bullet deals x4.5 Dmg →
[*] New effect → +1% damage per coin[/list][/list][list]
[*] Canteen:[list]
[*] Effect removed → Heal 10 every 30s
[*] New effect → +10% speed per second standing still, speed is released when moving
[*] Quality: 2 → 1[/list][/list][list]
[*] Cigarettes:[list]
[*] Effect changed: -5 HP (30s) → +10 Dead HP (30s)[/list][/list][list]
[*] Wrench:[list]
[*] Effect changed: -25% Attack Speed → -25% Reload[/list][/list][list]
[*] Stitches:[list]
[*] Effect removed → -25 Lvl Stats
[*] Reduced xp gained by taking damage slightly[/list][/list][list]
[*] Brain Bites:[list]
[*] Effect changed: -60 Life → +60 Dead HP[/list][/list][list]
[*] Cookies:[list]
[*] Effect changed: +30 HP and -5% Speed → +15 HP and +25 Heal[/list][/list][list]
[*] Diary:[list]
[*] Effect changed: +1% to all stats (Daily) → +2% Dmg, Ability Spd, and Contact Dmg (Daily) [/list][/list][list]
[*] Bandages:[list]
[*] Healing: 15 → 10
[*] Now cannot heal more than damage taken[/list][/list][list]
[*] Medkit:[list]
[*] Healing: 100 instant → 200 over 120s[/list][/list][list]
[*] Painkillers:[list]
[*] Now only activate on HP damage (not shield damage)[/list][/list][list]
[*] Shuriken:[list]
[*] Time between throws: Halved[/list][/list][list]
[*] Safe:[list]
[*] Coins dropped: Increased slightly[/list][/list][list]
[*] Backpack:[list]
[*] Item removed [/list][/list][list]
[*] Cat Charm:[list]
[*] Item removed [/list][/list][list]
[*] Energy Drink:[list]
[*] Item removed[/list][/list][list]
[*] Long Magazine:[list]
[*] Mag Size: +2 → +15% (min +1)[/list][/list][list]
[*] Drum Magazine:[list]
[*] Mag Size: +4 → +50% (min +3)[/list][/list][list]
[*] Fanny Pack:[list]
[*] Reload: -30% → -20%
[*] Attack Speed: +20% → +30%[/list][/list][list]
[*] Beard:[list]
[*] Contact Damage per Level: +1 → +2[/list][/list][list]
[*] All Out:[list]
[*] Attack Speed: Capped at 1
[*] Cooldown: 60s → 40s and +1s per 4 bullets shot[/list][/list]

[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pistol:[list]
[*] Range: 300 → 350[/list][/list][list]
[*] Revolver:[list]
[*] Quality: 1 → 2[/list][/list][list]
[*] Mini Shotgun:[list]
[*] Range: 80 → 300[/list][/list][list]
[*] RPG:[list]
[*] Now reloads slower with increased magazine size like the other reload based weapons (like crossbow)[/list][/list][list]
[*] AK:[list]
[*] Damage: 27 → 37
[*] Attack Speed: +37%
[*] Mag Size: +7
[*] Reload Time: -50%
[*] Now loses accuracy while moving[/list]
[*] Crossbow:[list]
[*] Reload Time: 220ms → 200ms
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed weapons not applying magazine size bonuses when picked up
[*] Fixed weapons being picked up from the ground with replenished ammo
[*] Fixed reload-only weapons not firing immediately after reloading. These now ignore attack speed
[*] Fixed shield sometimes blocking more damage than intended
[*] Fixed player dying at 1HP and HP display showing 0 when it actually had 1
[*] Fixed diagonal movement being faster than straight movement
[*] Adjusted player center for better calculations
[*] Fixed menu retaining selected options when reopened
[/list]
[b]Weapons & Bullets[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bullet trails cutting off when piercing enemies
[*] Decreased bullet trail lifetime by 50%
[*] Fixed bullets missing enemies near map edges
[*] Fixed bullets deleting before dealing damage when enemies are very close to the map border
[*] Fixed some bullets not ricocheting
[*] Fixed ricochet SFX being too loud
[*] Fixed piercing bullets only hitting one target if multiple are aligned
[*] Fixed some weapons missing or showing incorrect sprites for special bullets
[/list]
[b]Enemies & Drops[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed axe zombie unfairly resetting its lunge attack
[*] Fixed zombie ears (from the Ear Necklace item) facing the wrong direction when dropped
[*] Fixed drops (blood, coins, items) spawning too far away when enemies die with high knockback
[/list]
[b]Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Molotov ability spawning the Molotov at the player’s feet instead of the center
[*] Fixed Clockshot ability showing no animation if the player swapped weapons while active
[*] Fixed player being able to move while *All Out* ability is active
[*] Fixed only one weapon firing when dual-wielding with manual shooting mode active
[/list]
[b]Crashes & Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare crash when viewing certain bestiary entries
[*] Centered some items and weapons more accurately
[*] Fixed incorrect shadow sizes on some items
[/list]

notes.title: Under Dead 0.9.3
notes.content:
[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*] Attack, reload, and ability speed are no longer exponential, and are now uncapped
[*] Leveling up is now +40% harder, but attack speed and reload increase by 40% instead of 25% each level
[*] Now if the player only has 1 secondary weapon, it will get a 25% attack speed and reload bonus
[*] Decreased player speed by 10%
[*] Increased speed when the player is not holding a weapon: +10% → +20%
[*] Accuracy is now negatively uncapped and can go below 0
[*] Now, weapons have a small cooldown after switching so they don’t shoot instantly
[/list]


[h3]New Mechanic: Dead HP[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now when the player hits 0 HP, he will not die but slowly start gaining dead HP, which blocks max HP
[*] The more dead HP you have, the slower you move
[*] If dead HP blocks all your maximum HP, you die
[*] You recover 20% dead HP each day survived; that’s the only way to regain your HP
[/list]


[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can reroll the shop infinitely after using the free shop rerolls, but it costs coins
[*] Now the price difference between quality 0 and quality 3 items is bigger
[*] Items are slightly cheaper
[*] The price of the food machine increases more each day
[*] Increased length of day 15
[*] Increased day length of days 5 to 9
[*] Entrepreneur class now starts with big pockets item instead of coin roll item
[*] Medical boxes now heal 20 instead of 30
[*] Shield is more transparent so HP can be seen better
[*] Follow HP is now darker
[*] Game option “No reroll” has been removed
[*] Hazard is now called difficulty
[*] The game’s version is no longer shown on the screen
[/list]


[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now more enemies will spawn when you return from the shop depending on the day and how many there were before
[*] Enemies gain half less speed per day
[*] Increased the maximum amount of enemies that can be at the same time, and now some small enemies like rats and spiders don’t count
[*] Now the quantity of zombies in a horde is affected by difficulty
[*] Fire spawned from fire zombies will last 50% less
[*] Spider eggs now always spawn a minimum of 2 spiders, increased maximum spiders from 5 to 6
[*] Rat groups are 25% less common
[*]Decreased enemy spawning on days 5 to 9, but zombie groups spawn faster
[/list]

[b]Zombie HP changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Zombie: 90 → 80
[*] Zombie fat: 150 → 160
[*] Zombie weapon: 110 → 120
[*] Zombie saw: 190 → 140
[*] Zombie toxic: 320 → 220
[/list]

[b]Day spawn start changes:[/b][list]
[*] Zombie scientist: 5 → 12
[*] Zombie police: 5 → 6
[*] Zombie military: 5 → 7
[/list]


[h3]Survivors[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased survivor speed by 40%
[*] Now survivors will only go towards the platform if they are near it
[*] Survivors will now return to follow the player if the platform closes
[*] Now when survivors spawn, they will not go too close to the platform or too far
[*] Survivor spawn immortality increased from 3.5s to 4s
[*] Survivors now drop more coins depending on the day
[*] Survivors now can’t spawn too early in the day or too late
[*] Now only 3 survivors can spawn on days 1 to 4, and 3 on days 5 to 9
[/list]


[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new items
[*] Moved drink items from the food pool to the general item pool
[*] Renamed pocket shooter to Big Pockets 
[*] Added item descriptions for abilities and bullet items
[/list]

[list][*] Gun Guide:[list]
[*] Attack Speed: +10% → +20%[/list][/list][list]
[*] Gloves:[list]

notes.title: Under Dead 0.9: Gameplay Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on making the game more challenging and less linear
Enemies are more of a threat, and items have a much more significant impact
Also, now when you level up, you can actually feel an increase in power

[h3]Enemy generation:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complete reworked enemy spawning: many more enemies will spawn, and the generation is much less linear while still being fair
[*] More enemies will spawn when returning from the shop, and they can be any enemy now, not just the basic zombie
[*] Rare enemies are now more rare
[/list]
[h3]Survivors:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survivors will now follow you if you get close to them; when night comes, they will automatically go to the platform
[*] Survivors can no longer spawn too early in the day or too late
[*] Survivors no longer spawn on day 10, now, they spawn from day 1-9
[*] One more survivor will spawn in every game, increasing from 5 to 6
[*] The survivor help message now cannot go out of the camera, so you know when a survivor has appeared
[/list]
[h3]Leveling up:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leveling up no longer gives crit chance or luck, now, it gives attack speed and reload speed every 5 levels
[*] Made leveling up easier, but combos give less XP
[*] Made leveling up more satisfying
[/list]
[h3]General:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bullets will now pierce an enemy if it has 0 hp. For example, if you shoot an enemy with a shotgun, only the bullets that kill the enemy will be destroyed; the others will keep going and hit other enemies
[*] Damage numbers now only show one decimal
[*] Increased zombie delivery hp, now it can survive one sniper shot
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked Dual Weapon Handling: If you have two secondary weapons, they will fire in coordination instead of simultaneously
[*] Balanced crossbows and slingshots to shoot more slowly the more bullets they fire
[*] Reduced sniper rifle attack speed
[/list]
[h3]Items:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked many items to be more impactful
[*] Now, all food items give hp or heal
[*] Reduced the chance of medical items to spawn
[*] Made red items rarer
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed survivors having the same depth on the platform
[*] Fixed the level-up message not being centered
[*] Fixed diary item not giving luck
[/list]
